claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (APV-CMV, PEEP 5 cmH2O, FiO2 40%, set RR 14/min, tidal volume 360 mL) and monitor airway pressures, minute volume, and SpO2.

Reposition patient and implement pressure ulcer prevention protocol given Braden score indicating high risk.
Monitor neurological status with serial Richmond-RAS and CAM-ICU assessments.
Monitor vital signs and oxygen saturation closely, with alarms set for heart rate 50-130 bpm, SpO2 ≥93%, and blood pressure 90-160 mmHg.
